review_type: Read-only methodology review of proposed failure-only CV early rejection; no outcomes or fits produced.
logic: Positive qualification is a conjunction of mandatory per-fold and complete-matrix gates. Once an already observed required conjunct is false, no future fold can make that same predeclared conjunction true. Early rejection cannot create a positive qualification.
conditions: Create and commit a new append-only r3 protocol before any CV fit; preserve r2 and all frozen splits/gates/capacities/weights.
Fixed fold order0,1,2; retain r2 within-fold arm orders AB,BA,AB unless a separately explicit prospective amendment changes it.

A quality-delta stop requires both complete sealed A/B predictions from that fold and a valid independent pristine-label/per-class/support audit. Do not expose A outer scores to B before its predictions are sealed.

A demonstrable mandatory completion/integrity/resource/source/cleanup failure can reject without fitting further arms, but cleanup uncertainty must fail closed before further activity. Technical invalidity is not evidence that model quality is inferior.

Reject only on irreversible predeclared requirements: observed per-fold MacroF1 or ex-rarest delta not strictly positive, supported class delta below -0.01, or mandatory completion/integrity invalidity. A running aggregate, missing selection in one fold or projected cost/quality is not a quality-rejection rule.

Retain all3 declared folds and6 arm records. Every unattempted arm has null metrics and explicit not_attempted_due_prior_gate_failure linked to the sealed decisive audit. Never replace it with zero or omit it.

A partial rejected matrix has overall qualification FAIL and complete_CV=false; full3fold mean, pooled MacroF1 and exactly-once OOF coverage/quality claims stay null/unqualified. Valid individual observed fold outcomes may be reported with scope.
No Stage2 on failure, reseeding, replacement candidate/fold, retry, gate relaxation, time transfer or extension. Saved time is observed avoided future work, not a measured equal-budget gain.

Positive qualification remains impossible without all3 complete paired folds, exact once-only coverage/group-disjointness, all original per-fold gates, valid pooled/mean and all other original lifecycle requirements.
